data: Which of the following lines reaches the highest accuracy value for the 'NMT En-Fr - BiLSTM-max' model?

The question asks which line reaches the highest accuracy value for the 'NMT En-Fr - BiLSTM-max' model. From the caption, we know that the y-axis represents Accuracy. The figure is divided into four subfigures, but only one of them corresponds to the 'NMT En-Fr - BiLSTM-max' model. This subfigure is located in the top-left corner of the figure. 

In this subfigure, there are six lines representing different metrics: SentLen, TreeDepth, Tense, WordContent, TopConst, and BLEU (or PPL). The line representing BLEU (or PPL) is the one that reaches the highest accuracy value. Therefore, the answer is the line labeled 'BLEU (or PPL)'.
